status: M1 FIRST PASS. 1-D vertical simulation (sim1d) + analytic TVC sizing + component-build-up aero. The 6-DOF Monte Carlo (attitude, lateral, wind, sensors, TVC dynamics) supersedes the tilt/lateral items in v2. Engine map = GNC placeholder from ENGINE-BASELINE v0 (eps 3, port 30 mm): combustion.json v1 (eps 2, helical port, Isp map) and electronics.json v1 arrived during M1 and are integrated in gnc.json v2 (M2). Predictions, not hardware validation.

recommended_baseline.tag: DERIVED descent-attitude trade (1-D + analytic TVC; 6-DOF confirmation in v2)
recommended_baseline.note: Full-thrust ascent -> MECO on predicted apogee (300 m) -> nose-first coast -> nose drogue at apogee -> engine-down (tail-first) descent at ~18-21 m/s under drogue -> relight planned on the worst-case ignition delay (0.6 s) at ~25-30 m -> drogue released on Pc-confirmed ignition -> throttled TVC landing burn (velocity-tracking guidance, gate 4 m / 1 m/s) -> touchdown ~1 m/s -> engine cut on contact.

why: drogue sets attitude (engine-down) and settles the N2O liquid aft for the relight (drag ~ weight -> ~1 g settling)
relight speed ~20 m/s instead of ~57 m/s free-fall: landing burn impulse and propellant ~25 % lower, TVC demand at relight 1-2 deg instead of 4-7 deg (adverse aero)
drogue doubles as a degraded recovery path (vehicle loss but low-energy impact ~20 m/s, 2.4 kJ) if the relight fails
single relight only (2 starts per flight) - ENG-04 >= 3 leaves one spare start
costs_and_risks: wind drift under drogue: ~15 s from 300 m -> 100-120 m downwind at 8 m/s unless the ascent is biased upwind (6-DOF v2 quantifies)
drogue release mechanism and line/plume clearance at relight (Lauty: release + swivel at the nose)
relight at ~25-30 m leaves no time for a backup main parachute if ignition fails (ignition reliability is mission-critical)

baseline_numbers.tag: SIM sim1d DC-A1 nominal (floor 20 %, placeholder engine map)

alternatives.A-F free-fall: same as A-D without drogue: ~57 m/s tail-first relight at ~120 m, needs an attitude solution during the unstable tail-first fall (no aero stability at small AoA) - not recommended
alternatives.B continuous-burn hop: no relight; ascent, throttle to the floor through apex and descent. Propellant cost grows steeply with floor and apex (100 m: 1.44 kg at 12.5 %, 2.06 kg at 20 %, 3.1 kg at 25 %); infeasible without ballast when T_floor >= W. Used for the test campaign (low hops) and as an ACEMA fallback only with the 12.5 % floor.
alternatives.A-RCS (N2O cold-gas attitude) / A-flaps: kept as research options in REPORT (impulse, mass, valve count); not baseline at v1

test_campaign: T1 static fires (DC-D): ignition latency/repeatability (>= 30 starts), throttle map and Pc loop (10-90 % time, slew, resolution, floor stability), 3 starts per run, gimbal sweeps under thrust, thrust-vector alignment, ENGINE ROLL TORQUE measurement
T2 tethered hover (DC-C): 0.5-2 m, hover/doublets/TVC attitude hold, estimator and thrust-effectiveness estimator check, abort on tether
T3 low hops (B, 5-50 m) with the hover-capable floor; legs fixed; landing guidance and lateral divert
T4 relight hop (A-D mini: MECO ~60-100 m, drogue, relight at ~25 m)

floor_frac_required_max.tag: DERIVED landing closure (SIM mc1d v1p2_m115) + hover rule
floor_frac_required_max.note: GNC requirement for HOVER CAPABILITY of RV-1 (landing mass 11.9-12.4 kg): T_floor <= 0.9 W needs floor <= 20 % (11.3 kg window). Needed for the tethered-hover tests (DC-C), low hops (B: P 0.978 at 20 % vs 0.864 at 25 %, 1-D) and the hover-capable landing mode (terminal 1 m/s descent with time for lateral/attitude correction). ENG-02 'required <= 25 %' remains ACCEPTABLE FOR THE A-D FLIGHT through the hoverslam fallback (1-D P = 1.000 at 25 %, 0.992 at 40 %, with the accelerometer thrust-effectiveness estimator) - provisional until the 6-DOF shows hoverslam meets the lateral (<= 0.5 m/s) and tilt (<= 5 deg) touchdown criteria.

floor_frac_acceptable_flight_with_hovers.tag: REQ ENG-02 rev1 + SIM mc1d v1p2_m115 (1-D)

floor_frac_goal.note: keeps the hover window open down to 7.1 kg landing mass; best propellant economy for hops
